title: Best Refurbished Smartphones to Buy in the UK (2026)
content_html:
Buying refurbished can be one of the easiest ways to get a flagship-level phone for less. This guide looks at the smartphone models we would check first in the UK if value matters more than having a factory-sealed box.

Rather than chasing one exact listing, we focus on models with plenty of supply so you can compare condition, storage, seller reputation and warranty before buying.

Some links in this article are affiliate links.

1. Apple iPhone 15 — best all-round iPhone choice

The iPhone 15 is a strong place to start if you want a relatively recent Apple phone without paying full retail price.

Check current refurbished iPhone 15 listings on eBay UK

2. Samsung Galaxy S24 — best Samsung flagship value

The Galaxy S24 is worth checking if you prefer Android and want a compact premium handset.

Check current refurbished Galaxy S24 listings on eBay UK

3. Google Pixel 8 — best camera-focused value

The Pixel 8 can be particularly attractive in the refurbished market thanks to its strong camera and clean Android experience.

Check current refurbished Google Pixel 8 listings on eBay UK

4. Apple iPhone 13 — best lower-cost iPhone

The iPhone 13 remains a sensible choice when the priority is reducing spend while still getting a modern iPhone experience.

Check current refurbished iPhone 13 listings on eBay UK

5. Samsung Galaxy S23 — best cheaper Samsung flagship

If the S24 is still more than you want to spend, the Galaxy S23 is often the model we would compare next.

Check current refurbished Galaxy S23 listings on eBay UK

What matters most when buying refurbished?

Check condition grade, battery information where available, storage, whether the phone is unlocked, seller feedback, returns and warranty.

Guide updated September 2026. Prices, availability and product condition change regularly, so always check the live listing before purchasing.
